title: Declared plan bounds are enforced and fail closed
intended_use: An X-Verse engineer relies on the declared activation-plan bounds so that an over-bound input fails closed instead of being derived or activated.
expected: Declared activation-plan bounds are enforced; an out-of-bound input is not derived.
environment: candidate checkout, offline; the C++ bound-matrix cases (T20-BND-*) provide the primary unit evidence for each DecodeLimits member.
